result.reason: The added language covers the principal preferred vendor-indemnity triggers, but it omits the required notice, defense-control, and cooperation procedures and does not limit Client’s indemnity to Client-provided content and Client’s breach of law. It also does not satisfy the fallback because it lacks customary IP exclusions and remedies and a 3× annual-fees super-cap. The unnecessary reordering and overlapping indemnity language make the revision less minimal, while duplicative phrasing such as “hold Client harmless, its affiliates ... harmless” reduces drafting quality. Unrelated commercial intent is otherwise preserved.
